reviewer: English source-alignment reviewer, separate from the original edition author
disposition: Keep existing English without wholesale retranslation. Every paragraph and table cell was read against Chinese. The solitary-subject criterion, two meanings of value, anti-ranking restrictions, resonance versus price, two pearl/casket locks, and deferred proof burdens are retained. Some coined English phrases are deliberate metaphors; no argument-changing omission found.
limitations: Semantic comparison against the supplied Chinese, not independent verification of every philosophical claim.
